name: product_sign
description: Infer sign of product of two explicitly signed integers; control selects the larger magnitude using the same format.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
a=[];c=[]
for i in range(120):
 x=random.choice([-1,1])*random.randrange(1,10);y=random.choice([-1,1])*random.randrange(1,10)
 stem=f'Let a = {x} and b = {y}. '
 a.append({'prompt':stem+'Is a * b positive or negative? Answer:','answer':' '+('positive' if x*y>0 else 'negative')})
 c.append({'prompt':stem+'What is the larger of |a| and |b|? Answer:','answer':' '+str(max(abs(x),abs(y)))})
json.dump({'items':a,'control':c},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
